For visitors

Not for newcomers to group riding. The slower Bridge Ride follows the same route 5 to 10 minutes later. Bring water and food, and a helmet.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 20–22 mph on average: fast — for riders who race or train. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the A+ Pace Road Ride with Full Spectrum Racing group ride

A+ Pace Road Ride with Full Spectrum Racing is a road group ride in Richmond, VA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Blue Ridge Cyclery Richmond.

The fast option of the shop’s two Saturday rides, new for 2026, run with Full Spectrum Racing. It rolls out as a casual B+ ride and becomes an A+ drop ride (21+ mph, 20-22 mph average) after Hilliard Rd in Lakeside. There are two sprint zones before the water stop in Ashland, and the ride ends back at the shop.
